neighbours.label: bird taxonomy: names of bird families and groups (Psittacidae, passerines, woodpeckers) in a classification context
fire: Kingfishers belong to the family Alcedinidae, together with the kookaburras.
The guide covers all passerines found in the region, from larks to finches.
Owls are grouped in the order Strigiformes, separate from the hawks.
Hummingbirds of the family Trochilidae are found only in the Americas.
Among the songbirds, warblers and thrushes are the most common in spring.
Herons and egrets form the family Ardeidae within the wading birds.
The volume on cuckoos to parrots includes detailed range maps.
Woodpeckers, toucans and barbets are placed in the order Piciformes.
quiet: Otters belong to the family Mustelidae, together with the badgers.
The guide covers all rodents found in the region, from mice to squirrels.
Bats are grouped in the order Chiroptera, separate from the shrews.
Sea lions of the family Otariidae are found along cold coasts.
Among the antelopes, gazelles and impalas are the most common in spring.
Salmon and trout form the family Salmonidae within the bony fishes.
The volume on whales to dolphins includes detailed range maps.
Wolves, foxes and jackals are placed in the family Canidae.
